recentItems.title: Swayamvar Jhale Siteche (1974) | Uma, Balakram, Raja Mayekar | स्वयंवर झालं सीतेचे | Marathi Movie
recentItems.description:
Watch the timeless Marathi mythological classic "Swayamvar Jhale Siteche (1974)", a beautiful cinematic adaptation inspired by the legendary Sita Swayamvar from the Ramayana.

This classic Marathi film portrays the divine love story of Lord Rama and Goddess Sita, showcasing the unforgettable moment when Lord Rama breaks Lord Shiva's mighty bow to win Sita's hand in marriage. Filled with devotion, tradition, emotional performances, and soulful music, this movie remains one of the memorable mythological classics in Marathi cinema.

If you enjoy Ramayana-based films, Marathi mythological classics, devotional cinema, and vintage Marathi movies, then this masterpiece is a must-watch.

🎬 Movie Details

Movie: Swayamvar Jhale Siteche (1974)
Marathi Title: स्वयंवर झालं सीतेचे
Starring: Uma, Balakram, Raja Mayekar, Chandrakant Mandre, Lalita Desai, Sumati Gupte & Others
Music: Vasant Desai
Producer: Homi Wadia
Director: Madhukar Pathak

Synopsis

Based on one of the most celebrated episodes of the Ramayana, this film beautifully depicts the sacred Sita Swayamvar, where kings and princes from across Bharat gather in King Janaka's court to win Princess Sita's hand.

The mighty bow of Lord Shiva becomes the ultimate challenge, but only Lord Rama possesses the divine strength to lift and break it. The film celebrates devotion, righteousness, love, sacrifice, and the triumph of Dharma.

With graceful performances, traditional storytelling, and devotional music, Swayamvar Jhale Siteche continues to be a treasured Marathi mythological classic loved by generations.

🙏 Enjoy this Marathi Classic and experience the divine story of Lord Rama & Goddess Sita.

Movie Story
This film based on the Tantric legend about the guru Machhindranath (Tembe) and his disciple Gorakh (Master Vinayak) on the subject of 'maya' (belief in the illusory nature of worldly temptations). The guru appears to his student to have entered the kingdom of man-hating women, married the queen (Khote) and abandoned his commitment to celibacy and pure thoughts. Gorakh sets out to rescue him but the entire experience turns out to be an 'illusion' set up by the master.

This film chronicles the life of Sant Tukaram, one of Maharashtra’s greatest saint-poets. The episodic story portrays Tukaram’s conflict with the Brahmin Salomalo, who accuses him of fraud and tries to suppress his teachings, only to be humbled by divine justice.

recentItems.description:
Watch the award-winning Marathi biographical film Mahatma Phule (1954), based on the inspiring life of महान समाज सुधारक Jyotirao Govindrao Phule.

Directed by Pralhad Keshav Atre and written by B. R. Ambedkar, this powerful film highlights the struggle for social equality, education, and justice in 19th century India.

The film beautifully portrays how Jyotiba Phule and his wife Savitribai Phule worked tirelessly to uplift marginalized communities and pioneered women’s education in Maharashtra.

🏆 This film won the prestigious National Film Award at the 2nd National Film Awards, making it one of the most important Marathi films of its time.

recentItems.description:
Watch Ramshastri (1944) Full Marathi Movie exclusively on Eagle Marathi Movies.

Ramshastri is a legendary Marathi historical drama based on the inspiring life of Ramshastri Prabhune, the fearless chief justice of the Maratha Empire, known for his honesty, courage, and commitment to justice.

The story unfolds during a turbulent period in Maratha history after the death of Prime Minister Madhavrao. The ambitious and ruthless Raghoba seizes power by murdering King Narayanrao and his son. Amid political betrayal and tyranny, Ramshastri becomes the only voice brave enough to challenge injustice and uphold truth.

A timeless classic of Marathi cinema, Ramshastri beautifully portrays integrity, morality, and the power of standing against oppression.
